document.about: PLoS ONE (2009) article, 'New Insights into the Diversity of Marine Picoeukaryotes', PMC2747013, set by a journal production system that draws each accented letter as the letter and a spacing accent placed over it (`e` then `´`), and an accented i as a dotless `ı` under the accent. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.
